relevance_note: Single-patient case report of LAD-I diagnosed by flow cytometry ("the diagnosis of LAD1 was made by demonstrating reduced neutrophil CD11b surface expression"); no ITGB2 variant is reported, and the Discussion summarises three earlier reports with individual-level facts.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON. No genetic testing or ITGB2 variant is reported for anyone, so the variants table is empty. Previously published people (Discussion): ref [2] three siblings (feature given for all three, so recorded per sibling with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'; sibling order arbitrary), ref [3] 5-year-old girl, ref [4] 11-year-old boy. Contradictions/inconsistencies: Abstract says re-admitted '3 weeks later' while the case text says 're-admitted after 2 weeks'; Abstract says 'prednisone' while the case text says 'prednisolone'; text says 'complete absence of CD11a/CD18' for ref [3] while that reference's title says 'partial deficiency'; Discussion calls the patient 'moderate LAD1' without stating CD18 expression levels. Episodic 'elevated acute-phase reactants' recorded observed alongside 'Serum CRP was negative' (excluded elevated CRP) at admission; not treated as a direct contradiction. Whole-evaluation negatives ('Repeated evaluations for inflammatory bowel disease, hematologic, and rheumatic diseases were negative', 'Systemic examination was unremarkable') recorded as written, not used to exclude more specific items. Checklist: 'no history of ... periodontitis' does not exclude the composite 'periodontitis or gingivitis'; 'oral thrush' absence does not exclude 'fungal infections'; IBD negative does not exclude 'colitis or gastrointestinal inflammatory disease'; 'weight and height were appropriate for age and sex' not used to exclude failure to thrive; 'overwhelming systemic infection' not recorded as sepsis; PG lesions were sterile, so 'skin or soft tissue infections' is not reported. Lab values given only with normal ranges (C3, immunoglobulins, Hb) were not turned into features. deceased_age not stated (death after re-admission, exact age not given). n_patients_reported = 1 counts the single LAD-I patient, who has no reported ITGB2 variant.
